# S346 — A paused run cannot get the permission it was denied without stopping every run in the project

**Findings:**  · **Size:** S · **Tree:**

**Not in this slice:**

## Why

Observed 2026-11-11 (slicer s453): the gate failed only because the implementer was denied `git mv`; the owner chose to allow it and retry, but `ork projects set slicer --allow ...` was refused ("project slicer has unfinished runs: ... (s455 running), ... (s453 paused)"). The fix waits for an unrelated slice (s455) to land, then the paused run is stopped and retried. Wanted: a per-run grant on retry (e.g. `ork retry RUN --allow PATTERN`), or let --allow change for runs that are paused, since they read it at their next round.
